subject: Crew slate: request to reassign one runtime slot + band reconciliation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Crew slate: request to reassign one runtime slot + band reconciliation

Marcus / Kimberly — attaching the updated HC slate for Q4 (HC_Q4_crew_slate_v2.xlsx) and a short comp-band summary. We have a near-term request from the AstraCloud POC team to accelerate a runtime infra hire (senior infra engineer) to support their integration work; net headcount request is +1, but I can propose a reallocation instead of net-new if leadership signs off.

Ask: can we reassign 1 open slot currently reserved for Edge (Platform) to Runtime/Infra and confirm the comp band at Senior IC (L5) with the standard band cap? The candidate profile we've been tracking maps to the L5 payband.

Notes: 
- The attached slate shows slot origin and proposed destination (tab 'moves').
- comp_band_summary.pdf highlights the recommended payband and suggested offer midpoint (falls within our budget).
- If we do a slot-swap we preserve overall headcount forecast for the quarter, which keeps the hiring budget intact.

I recommend marking this as an internal reallocation and sending the finalized slate to Finance for quick sign-off. If we need a one-off override for the band cap, I can loop in Lauren for exec approval.

Next steps suggested: Marcus to confirm operational priority; Kimberly to validate budget/cost impact; Lauren to approve band override if needed.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Hiring Partner, Infrastructure & Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HC_Q4_crew_slate_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), comp_band_summary.pdf (doc)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crew slate: request to reassign one runtime slot + band reconciliation

Thanks Marissa — quick read and a couple questions before I greenlight the swap: 
1) Urgency: Is this candidate timeline blocking AstraCloud onboarding? If yes, we should prioritize.
2) Scope: Will this L5 role be dedicated to the Astra integration for more than 6 months (which would suggest we treat it as a product-facing hire rather than a transient integration headcount)?
3) Backfill: Which Edge role would we de-prioritize if we take the slot (I see two early-backlog positions in the slate).

Operationally I want to avoid moving a slot that causes a delivery gap on Edge features we already committed to this quarter. If this hire is critical to retaining AstraCloud (i.e., revenue risk), I can support the swap. Otherwise, let's explore a 3-month contractor bridge and revisit.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Runtime Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, finance-approvals@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-21T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crew slate: request to reassign one runtime slot + band reconciliation

Marissa — I reviewed the numbers in comp_band_summary.pdf and the XLS. A couple of comments from Finance: 
- Cost delta if we convert an Edge L4 slot to a Runtime L5 will be ~17% on target OTE for Q4 (line-level impact shown on tab 'cost-delta').
- If we do a straight slot swap (no net headcount change), we can keep within the quarterly budget envelope but will need an approval note in the HC tracker and a sign-off from Revenue Ops stating no impact to committed shipments to customers.

I asked finance-approvals to flag this thread for a fast-track review. Two options: 
A) Approve internal reallocation + L5 offer at midpoint (no band exception).
B) Approve reallocation + band exception to allow a higher starting comp for the candidate (requires Lauren sign-off and AP review).

Marcus — based on your earlier note about delivery risk, if this candidate is required to secure the AstraCloud deal, we recommend option B. Otherwise choose A and we will proceed with standard L5 midpoint.

Kimberly Park
Director, Finance Planning
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: comp_band_summary.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, finance-approvals@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-22T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crew slate: request to reassign one runtime slot + band reconciliation

Team — after reviewing the business case and the Astra renewal timeline, I approve option B: reallocate one Edge slot to Runtime/Infra as an L5 with a one-time band exception up to the redlined cap in comp_band_summary.pdf. Conditions: 
- Offer must include standard performance milestones tied to the Astra onboarding (6-week checkpoint + 16-week delivery milestones).
- Recruiting to start with the midpoint + 5% uplift; total comp must be justified in the offer memo.
- Please prepare a short note for the HC tracker describing the swap and attach the signed approval. Finance, please record the cost delta in the Q4 forecast.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Platform Product
Redwood Inference
